description: Executes a payout quote. Despite the name, this is the endpoint for payouts funded from a BlindPay-managed wallet on any network, Solana included; self-custodied EVM wallets must approve the token first. Execute before the quote expires (5 minutes). Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry cannot create a second payout. On development instances the payout completes on its own; request_amount 66600 makes it fail and 77700 makes it refunded.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

sender_wallet_address.description: Sender wallet address. Provide this OR wallet_id, not both.

wallet_id.description: BlindPay-managed wallet ID to send from. Provide this OR sender_wallet_address, not both.
